import re
import unicodedata

def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', title.lower())
    text = ''.join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    text = text.strip('-')[:50].rstrip('-')
    return text or 'untitled'

def chunk_by_size(items: list, max_bytes: int, size) -> list[list]:
    chunks: list[list] = []
    current: list = []
    total = 0
    for item in items:
        s = size(item)
        if current and total + s > max_bytes:
            chunks.append(current)
            current = []
            total = 0
        current.append(item)
        total += s
    if current:
        chunks.append(current)
    return chunks
